rows.source: From your first note to fingerstyle, blues and lead
rows.translation: Dari nada pertama hingga fingerstyle, blues, dan melodi utama

rows.source: Hold it, tune it, play your first notes.
rows.translation: Pegang, setem, lalu mainkan nada pertama Anda.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 “Hello, guitar” · unit summary

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: Senar paling tebal bernada paling rendah. Saat bermain, letaknya paling dekat dengan wajah Anda. Kita menyebutnya senar 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Setiap senar memiliki pasak penyetem di kepala gitar. Memutarnya mengubah tinggi nada. Timbre mendengarkan dan menunjukkan arah putarannya.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (6).
rows.translation: Senar dihitung dari yang paling tipis (1) hingga yang paling tebal (6).
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck the thickest string and let it ring.
rows.translation: Petik senar paling tebal dan biarkan berdering.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G, B, E. Try: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually.
rows.translation: Dari tebal ke tipis: E, A, D, G, B, E. Ingat huruf awal kalimat: Eka akan datang guna belajar esok.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-2 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Play strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Mainkan senar 6, 5, dan 4, satu per satu.

rows.source: Put your fingertip just behind the metal fret, not on top of it. Press firmly enough for a clean ring.
rows.translation: Letakkan ujung jari tepat di belakang logam fret, bukan di atasnya. Tekan secukupnya agar nada berbunyi jernih.

rows.translation: Terbuka, fret 1, fret 3: E, F, G.

rows.source: E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: E minor memakai dua jari di fret 2, pada senar 5 dan 4. Semua senar berbunyi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-4 “Your first chord: E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Sapukan tangan melewati keenam senar dari tebal ke tipis dengan satu gerakan halus. Jaga pergelangan tetap rileks.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-4 “Your first chord: E minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: This challenge mixes the whole unit: the open strings, E, F and G on string 1, and E minor. Take a breath between steps.
rows.translation: Tantangan ini menggabungkan seluruh unit: senar terbuka, E, F, dan G pada senar 1, serta E minor. Tarik napas di antara langkah.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From thick to thin, the open strings are…
rows.translation: Dari tebal ke tipis, senar terbuka adalah…

rows.source: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually: E A D G B E, string 6 to string 1.
rows.translation: Huruf awal Eka akan datang guna belajar esok: E A D G B E, dari senar 6 hingga senar 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · challenge gtr-1-5 “First-steps challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Urutan senar, dari tipis ke tebal

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes
rows.translation: Mary Punya Anak Domba: tiga nada

Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
rows.translation: Mary Punya Anak Domba membutuhkan tiga nada: senar 2 terbuka adalah B, fret 2 pada senar 3 adalah A, dan senar 3 terbuka adalah G. Jari kedua memainkan A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
rows.translation: Senar 3, fret 2, jari kedua. Itulah A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: senar 2 terbuka, lalu senar 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · song gtr-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Notes on strings 1 and 2, reading tab, and your first two tunes.
rows.translation: Nada pada senar 1 dan 2, membaca tab, dan dua melodi pertama Anda.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 “First melodies” · unit summary

rows.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.
rows.translation: Senar 2 bekerja seperti senar 1. Saat terbuka, nadanya B. Fret 1 dengan jari pertama menghasilkan C. Fret 3 dengan jari ketiga menghasilkan D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Senar 2, fret 1, jari pertama. Itulah C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
rows.translation: Senar 2, fret 3, jari ketiga. Itulah D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One finger per fret: fret 1 gets finger 1, fret 2 gets finger 2, fret 3 gets finger 3.
rows.translation: Satu jari per fret: fret 1 untuk jari 1, fret 2 untuk jari 2, fret 3 untuk jari 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rest your thumb on the back of the neck, behind your second finger. Your fingers can then arch and land on their tips.
rows.translation: Letakkan ibu jari di belakang leher gitar, berhadapan dengan jari kedua. Jari-jari pun dapat melengkung dan menekan dengan ujungnya.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-1 “Three notes on string 2” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: Tab menggambar enam garis, satu per senar, dengan senar 1 di atas. Angka pada garis menunjukkan fret yang ditekan. Angka 0 berarti mainkan senar terbuka.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…
rows.translation: Pada tab, angka 3 di garis teratas berarti…

rows.translation: Garis teratas adalah senar 1, yang paling tipis. Angkanya menunjukkan fret.
